name: Strahnbrad
summary: Syndicate brigands hold Strahnbrad, a ruined town in the northeastern heights of the Alterac Mountains. Near the Western Plaguelands border, it has fallen into decay since Prince Arthas Menethil defended it from Blackrock orc raiders.

sections.title: A Town of Tragedy
sections.body: Strahnbrad belonged to the Kingdom of Alterac until Lordaeron absorbed it after the Second War. On the eve of the Third War, Blackrock clan orcs raided the town to take human sacrifices for the Burning Legion. Prince Arthas Menethil rode to its defense with the Knights of the Silver Hand. He drove off the raiders and slew their slave master, but Strahnbrad was left bloodied. Soon after, the Scourge brought down Lordaeron, and the town was abandoned to the elements.

sections.title: The Syndicate's Grip
sections.body: The Syndicate uses Strahnbrad as an operations hub. Displaced Alteraci nobles and outlaws patrol the abandoned town hall and blacksmith, now their hideouts and staging grounds as they plan to reclaim their fallen realm. The Syndicate keeps supplies and captive labor in the ruins, including the orc Gol'dir. Horde scouts from Tarren Mill seek to free him.

faq.q: Why is Strahnbrad significant in history?
faq.answer: Prince Arthas Menethil's first celebrated stand came at Strahnbrad, where he defended the town from Blackrock orcs. Uther the Lightbringer sent him to protect the settlement. Arthas rescued townsfolk and cut down the raiders.
The Syndicate holds Strahnbrad. Human brigands loyal to Alterac's fallen noble bloodlines have fortified the ruined town hall and blacksmith as a staging ground for their ambitions in the mountains.

faq.q: Which kingdom did Strahnbrad belong to originally?
faq.answer: Strahnbrad first belonged to the Kingdom of Alterac, before the First War. After Alterac betrayed the Alliance during the Second War, the town came under the Kingdom of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this town?
faq.answer: The Syndicate captured Gol'dir, an orc, and forced him into brutal slave labor in Strahnbrad's ruins. Krusk directs Horde operatives from Tarren Mill to send adventurers through the Syndicate's defenses to free him.

angles.text: As a paladin, Strahnbrad's cobblestones recall Prince Arthas Menethil and Uther the Lightbringer in their early, untainted days. Their memory bitterly recalls how far Lordaeron's heroes have fallen.
As a member of the Horde, you know the Syndicate's enslavement of Gol'dir makes Strahnbrad an urgent target. Horde champions seek to strike the human brigands and rescue their kin.
